title: Persist task lifecycle and recover interrupted runs
description: Move the task registry from memory into the local SQLite database so task lifecycle, approvals and worker outcomes survive a Mastra restart. On startup, reconcile tasks that were running: mark them interrupted and never replay a worker run automatically. Today the registry is in memory only (src/mastra/tools/task-registry.ts).
why: Lost processes and duplicate side effects are the main failure cases in delegation.

acceptance.text: Tasks and approvals are stored in SQLite
Restart shows previous tasks with their last known state
Interrupted runs are marked interrupted and not re-run automatically
A test covers restart during a waiting approval

outcome.summary: Task registry persisted to assistant-tasks.db; active tasks are marked interrupted on restart and never replayed.
outcome.verifiedBy: npm run check; test:context 8/8; test:policy 14/14 (1 symlink skipped); test:acp 7/7; test:plantool 5/5
